title: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (LAWS)
stage_label: CCW GGE Report & Rolling Text Evolution
summary: Consensus 2023 Report of the GGE on LAWS establishing two-tier operationalization: prohibition of weapons systems that cannot be used in compliance with IHL or produce uncontrollable effects, and strict regulation (context, duration, geographic scope, human-machine interaction) of other autonomous weapons systems.
